title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first cylindrical object by setting the Euler angles to zero and the translation vector to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.1056, 0.1056) with a radius of 0.1056. Draw the second loop as a smaller circle with the same center but a radius of 0.046. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.2113. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0755 units along the normal direction and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The dimensions of this part are 0.2112936665691641 in length, 0.2112936665691641 in width, and 0.07546202377470146 in height.

For the second cylindrical object, create another new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector set to (0.5538, 0.5246, 0.0). On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.0981, 0.0981) with a radius of 0.0981. Draw the second loop as a smaller circle with the same center but a radius of 0.0302. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.1962. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the vector set to (0.5538, 0.5246, 0.0). Extrude the sketch 0.0755 units along the normal direction and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The dimensions of this part are 0.19620126181422382 in length, 0.19620126181422382 in width, and 0.07546202377470146 in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.1056, 0.1056)
    .circle(0.1056)
    .circle(0.046)
    .extrude(0.0755)
)

# Part 2
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0981, 0.0981)
    .circle(0.0981)
    .circle(0.0302)
    .extrude(0.0755)
    .translate((0.5538, 0.5246, 0.0))
)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

import cadquery as cq

# Two washer-shaped parts (annular cylinders) arranged diagonally

outer_d = 0.20   # outer diameter
inner_d = 0.07   # hole diameter
thk = 0.0755     # thickness

# First washer (lower-left in top view)
washer1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.10, 0.10)
    .circle(outer_d / 2.0)
    .circle(inner_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(thk)
)

# Second washer (upper-right in top view)
washer2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.65, 0.6208)
    .circle(outer_d / 2.0)
    .circle(inner_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(thk)
)

# Combine into a single compound part
r = washer1.union(washer2)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Two cylindrical rings (washers)
outer_dia = 0.20
inner_dia = 0.08
height = 0.0755

# First ring
ring1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_dia / 2).circle(inner_dia / 2).extrude(height)

# Second ring (offset in X and Y)
ring2 = ring1.translate((0.54, 0.60, 0))

r = ring1.union(ring2)
